title: Dependency caching
research_question: Under what lockfile, cache-key, and isolation conditions can dependency caching reduce setup time without using stale or cross-project data?

title: Remove redundant dependency setup
research_question: Which setup steps are demonstrably duplicated across jobs, and what state or isolation assumptions make reuse safe?

title: Shallow checkout
research_question: Does the workflow or its scripts require history, tags, or merge-base data before checkout depth can be reduced?

title: Parallelize independent jobs
research_question: Which jobs have no dependency or shared-artifact ordering constraints, and how do elapsed time and runner usage change?

title: Reuse job artifacts
research_question: Can an existing build artifact safely replace repeated work across jobs, with matching provenance and retention assumptions?

title: Review matrix execution cost
research_question: Can matrix cost be reduced without removing required operating-system, runtime, or version coverage?

title: Set job timeouts
research_question: What evidence supports a timeout that prevents hangs without terminating valid slow runs?

title: Change-aware workflow filtering
research_question: Can path or change filters preserve all required checks for every supported trigger and changed-file scenario?

title: Cancel stale runs
research_question: Which run types may be canceled safely, and could cancellation hide a required result or interrupt release-related work?
